question: Among all drivers born after 1980 who completed the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix, identify the youngest driver. For this driver, what was their position during their fastest lap time across all races they participated in?

  SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id, d.XCL_040 AS dob
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results r ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
  JOIN races rc ON rc.XCL_065 = r.XCL_074
  WHERE rc.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
    AND rc.XCL_066 = 2009
    AND d.XCL_040 > '1980-12-31'
    AND r.XCL_090 = 1
),
youngest AS (
  SELECT driver_id
  FROM eligible
  ORDER BY dob DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

         (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)

  WHERE r.XCL_075 = (SELECT driver_id FROM youngest)

FROM results r
JOIN best_lap b ON b.race_id = r.XCL_074

LIMIT 1
